one_line: New AI benchmarks released, major funding rounds announced, policy actions intensify, and AI systems deployed in real‑world settings.

themes.title: New benchmarks gauge AI capabilities
themes.text: SemiAnalysis introduced the GDPx benchmark covering 206 agentic tasks, where Anthropic’s Claude Opus 5.5 scored 12 percent. OpenAI released the LifeVal benchmark for everyday assistance tasks, and researchers reported that GPT‑6 Astra edited 0.016 percent of Qwen3.5‑0.8B weights, boosting math performance sixfold.

stories.headline: SemiAnalysis releases GDPx benchmark; Anthropic’s Claude Opus 5.5 scores 12%
OpenAI launches LifeVal benchmark for AI assistance with everyday tasks
GPT-6 Astra edits 0.016% of Qwen3.5-0.8B weights, boosting math performance sixfold

themes.title: AI firms secure major funding
themes.text: Salesforce agreed to buy Cresta for $2.7 billion, while Casap, Bites, Tutor Intelligence, and 42AI raised $56 million, $40 million, $75 million, and $62.5 million respectively. Alphabet and Oracle launched multi‑billion‑dollar bond and stock offerings to fund AI data‑center expansion, and Lumen announced expanded AI‑ready networking with Microsoft.

stories.headline: Salesforce to acquire Cresta for $2.7 billion
Casap raises $56 million Series B to expand AI dispute and fraud tools for banks
Bites raises $40 million Series A to expand AI‑driven frontline training platform
Tutor Intelligence raises $75 million Series B to expand robot model training and deployments
42AI emerges from stealth with $62.5 million seed to build behavioral world model
Alphabet launches €6 billion euro‑denominated bond sale, €17 billion demand
Oracle to raise $20 billion via stock and bond sales for AI data centers
Lumen and Microsoft expand co‑selling to deliver AI‑ready enterprise networks

themes.title: Policy moves target AI use
themes.text: Anthropic updated Claude Code’s system prompt to forbid recreating existing video games. The New York Times and other publishers sued Brave Software for alleged illegal AI scraping and paywall bypass. Anthropic disclosed $895.4 billion in compute purchase commitments and noted slower revenue growth amid financing concerns ahead of its IPO.

stories.headline: Anthropic adds rule to stop Claude Code from cloning existing video games
New York Times and other papers sue Brave over AI scraping and paywall bypass
Anthropic reports $895.4 billion in compute‑related purchase commitments and leases
Anthropic revenue growth slows as compute financing risks rise ahead of IPO

themes.title: AI applied in real‑world systems
themes.text: Google’s Project Suncatcher satellite ran the Gemma 4 model in orbit and returned a haiku. An AI agent using Anthropic’s Claude Sonnet 5 selected a gene‑therapy vector and controlled a surgical rig to inject a mouse brain. OpenAI announced a Grid Protectors program to partner with utilities for compute‑campus power reliability.

stories.headline: Google’s Project Suncatcher satellite generates first AI response in orbit
AI agent selects gene therapy and performs brain injection on live mouse
OpenAI launches Grid Protectors Program to aid utilities with compute campus power reliability
